findings.title: Search: discovery gap
findings.detail: Literal 4/4, intent 0/4. Intent/category queries return nothing — relevance gap.

findings.title: Recommendations not inspectable via the Store API
findings.detail: Not exposed via the WooCommerce Store API (related/upsell products are rendered server-side). Needs rendered capture to inspect.

items.issue: Literal 4/4, intent 0/4. Intent/category queries return nothing — relevance gap.
items.recommendation: Add synonym/intent handling (or a search app) so category and concept queries ("sofa", "seating") return products, not just literal product names.
Introduce a hierarchical category structure (parent/child) so shoppers can drill down instead of scanning a flat list.
